userStories.title: Scaffold project structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the project scaffolded with package.json, README, and .gitignore so the Node.js CLI has a proper foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json has type: module and a bin field pointing to index.js

userStories.title: Implement note saving logic
userStories.description: As a user, I want to save text notes to a local JSON file so my notes persist between sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Calling saveNote('test') appends { text: 'test', timestamp: ISO } to notes.json
Multiple calls append to the array, not overwrite
First run creates notes.json if it doesn't exist
Malformed JSON in notes.json produces a clear error

userStories.title: Implement note reading logic
userStories.description: As a user, I want to read all my saved notes so I can review what I've written.
acceptanceCriteria: readNotes() returns the full notes array when file exists
readNotes() returns [] when notes.json doesn't exist
Malformed JSON prints error to stderr

userStories.title: Wire CLI argument parsing and make executable
userStories.description: As a user, I want to run 'node index.js save <text>' and 'node index.js read' from the command line.
acceptanceCriteria: node index.js save 'hello world' appends a note
node index.js read prints all saved notes to stdout
Unknown command prints usage help to stderr
save with no text argument shows error
